PlayLog.title: PlayLog
PlayLog.description: Analytics log recorded every time a player answers a question or matches an element

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier for the current browser visit

questionId.description: Identifier of the question or prompt

elementSymbol.description: Chemical symbol or name of the target element

gameMode.description: The active game mode, e.g. quiz, property-match, drag-drop

answerTime.description: Seconds taken to answer the question

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp string when the answer was submitted

sessionDuration.description: Elapsed seconds since the player started the app session

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Game rating and feedback reviews from players

userId.description: Player identifier or guest user ID

/play_logs/{logId}.description: Collection of gameplay analytics events and answer logs for learning curve evaluation

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Collection of user game ratings and reviews
